function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period, SUM(revenue_cad) AS revenue_cad, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(revenue_cad)/SUM(qty) AS avg_selling_price_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period","purpose":"Overall ASP per period"}
